additional_concerns: All 12 required pairs are retained. The NOT_APPLICABLE findings concern only the exact typed gift questions; they neither authorize pruning these supported advertising duties nor certify any candidate as correct.

The packet supplies the service description, the gift-classification qualification, the gift restriction and footnote 4. Assertions in the claims that these passages are missing are stale. The external instruments identified by those passages remain distinct from the supplied circular.

For further external-authority review, the packet lacks the Code of Conduct paragraph 3.11, the answer to question 1 of the SFC Code of Conduct FAQs issued on 30 September 2010 identified in footnote 3, and paragraph 2.3 referenced by the advertising duty. Their absence does not negate duties expressly stated in the circular. No supplied external dependency IDs exist, and source unit IDs must not be substituted.

The component candidates are not operationally equivalent under the declared runtime semantics. node.142f34016b300f5c110eb249 and node.bc55be7e973a689d07f9e64b place only distributor status in scope; node.2a6321b4ce90763bf0be564e also places the offer occurrence in scope; node.97af37a2579f59b0ee43211f places the combined offer-and-promotion fact in scope. A known absence of an offer or promotional link can therefore produce FALSE in one candidate and OUT_OF_SCOPE in another. Unknown scope can also prevent a known non-gift or discount fact from determining the result. The intended question domain must resolve these alternatives.

Both offer-level candidates combine an offer-wide promotional connection with an existential non-discount gift fact. Unless the supplied classifications bind the promotional connection to the same offered component, they may catch an unrelated gift merely because another part of the offer promotes a product. The source connects the gifts themselves to the relevant promotion. Component-linked assessment and aggregation require explicit attribution.

node.968dbccb08282a4e8a580ae5 explicitly requires sufficient evidence before finding no qualifying component and retains unresolved classification as unknown. node.bca408c75cbf8467afafada6 does not state this evidentiary condition in its aggregate fact definition. The shared UNKNOWN semantics do not themselves prove that upstream component enumeration is complete or that unknown component classifications are supplied correctly.

The source says additional returns or incentives may be considered gifts; it does not classify every guaranteed return or incentive automatically. Gift and discount classifications remain supplied judgments, not implemented legal determinations. The absence of a structured-product finding does not exempt an arrangement from the gift restriction.

The circular defines distributors through distribution of SFC-authorised funds, while its quotation of paragraph 3.11 refers to investment products generally. Candidates differ in how explicitly they preserve the circular's narrower context. Preserve the alternatives of implementing only the selected circular scope and implementing the broader Code provision; the latter needs the external Code text and an explicit scope decision.

The component exception must concern the assessed component itself. A discount elsewhere in a combined offer cannot establish the exception for a separate gift. Conversely, the supplied text does not establish a general prohibition on every additional return or incentive, or an exception based on who funds or fulfils a gift.

FALSE for a prohibition question, TRUE for node.6d6e7adc6faa9d94b74c08e5's selected-control compliance question, and OUT_OF_SCOPE are not general legal permissions. Separate advertising, structured-product and other duties may remain applicable.

The candidates refer to a stated source interval, but the supplied material does not identify concrete assessment dates or the effective versions of the incorporated external authorities. Temporal applicability remains unresolved; no present-day validity conclusion follows from this review.
